landing.heroTitle: Everyone gets a gift they'll love.
landing.heroDescription: Build a wishlist and share it with a single link. Your people reserve gifts so nobody doubles up, and can team up on the bigger ones.
landing.heroNoAccount: Your people can see the list without an account. A free account is all it takes to reserve or join in.
landing.demoCardLabel: Example list, “Maman's 60th”: the ceramic dutch oven is reserved by someone close, and the weekend in the Luberon has a pot at €310 of €500.
landing.stepsSubtitle: Three steps, and nothing left to coordinate.
landing.step1Desc: Add each wish with its name, its price and a link to the shop.
landing.step2Desc: Send it by message or email, the way you normally would.
landing.step3Desc: Each person reserves a gift, or teams up with others on a bigger one.
landing.guestTitle: Your people can look without an account.
landing.guestDesc: They open the link on their phone and see the list right away. To reserve a gift, join a pot or leave a comment, a free account is all it takes.
landing.guestPhoneLabel: Preview of the shared list on a phone, visible without an account: the linen apron can be reserved, and reserving needs a free account.
landing.guestPhoneCaption: Visible without an account. A free account is all it takes to reserve.
landing.potDescription: For a gift too expensive for one person, a pot gathers what each person wants to give and tracks progress toward the price. Everyone can see it except whoever created the list, so the surprise stays whole.
landing.potPoint1: Only the pot's organiser sees who pledged what
landing.potPoint2: A pledge can be changed or cancelled until the event date
landing.potPoint3: Everyone sees how full the pot is, except whoever created the list
landing.potNote: Kageo doesn't handle any payment. The pot keeps track of what each person pledges, and the money moves between you.
landing.potCardLabel: Example pot on the weekend in the Luberon: €310 pledged toward €500, 6 people taking part.
landing.surpriseDesc: Reservations, pots and comments from other people are hidden from whoever created the list. Everyone else sees them.
landing.guestViewNote: What is reserved, and how full the pots are.
landing.privacy2Title: Private or public, list by list.

landing.privacy3Desc: Kageo makes money from optional premium features, not from your address book.
landing.ctaDescription: It takes about two minutes, and it's free.

featuresPage.multiUserText: Invite collaborators with different roles (owner, editor, viewer) to manage or contribute to your wishlists.

featuresPage.tabbedText: Easily switch between your owned wishlists and those shared with you using a clean tabbed navigation.
featuresPage.customizeText: Edit wishlist details, add cover images, and categorize your lists for better organization.
featuresPage.ownershipText: Always know who owns a wishlist, whether it's yours or shared by someone else.
featuresPage.ctaDescription: Join Kageo today and transform the way you create, manage, and share your desires.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draftNotice: This policy is a draft that has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer.

sections.title: What Kageo is
paragraphs: Kageo lets you keep wishlists, share them, and coordinate with the people you share them with: reserve a gift, mark it as bought, suggest a wish, chip in on a pot, comment.

sections.title: What we store
paragraphs: We only store what the app needs to work:
items: Your account: name, email address and a password hash (we never store your password itself). If you sign in with Google, we receive your name and email from Google and store no password.
Your date of birth, only if you choose to add it. It is visible only to you.
What you create: wishlists, wishes, comments, and the email addresses you invite.
What you do on other people's lists: reservations, purchases, pledges to pots, pots you organise, comments and suggested wishes.
The date you accepted these terms, recorded at sign-up.
Short-lived technical counters that limit abuse (sign-in attempts, invitations, writes), keyed by your IP address or email address. They expire on their own, within a day.

sections.title: Why we may use your data
items: To provide the service you asked for (your account, your lists, reservations, pots, invitations): this is the contract formed by the terms of use.
To keep Kageo secure and prevent abuse (rate limits, sign-in protection): our legitimate interest.
For what is optional and yours to decide (your date of birth, your public profile, signing in with Google): your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.

sections.title: What we do not do
items: We do not handle payments. A pot only records pledges; the money moves outside Kageo.
We use no advertising, no analytics and no tracking cookies, and we do not sell or share your data for marketing.

We send no marketing email. Kageo only emails you for something you asked for: an invitation you send to someone (they get one message about that list, sent in your name) or a password-reset link you request.

sections.title: Who can see what
items: A public wishlist is visible to anyone with the link and is shown on your public profile. A private wishlist is visible to the people you invite and to anyone who has the link, and is not shown on your profile.
Surprises are kept: the owner of a wishlist never sees its pots or the comments guests leave on it.
The organiser of a pot sees each person's name and pledged amount. Other guests only see the total.
If you turn on your public profile, your name, the date you joined and your public wishlists are visible to everyone. Otherwise your profile is private.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: Kageo sets only what it needs to run, so there is no cookie banner. The cookie policy gives the full list:
items: Sign-in cookies (session and security tokens) keep you logged in.
A language cookie and a theme setting (cookie and local storage) remember your choices.
A local-storage entry remembers that you dismissed the “install the app” banner.

sections.title: Service providers
paragraphs: Your data is processed by the services that run Kageo: Vercel (hosting), Upstash (the Redis-compatible database that stores everything, provided through Vercel), Resend (sending the invitation and password-reset emails; it receives the recipient’s address and the message) and, if you choose it, Google (sign-in). When you add an image link to a wish, visitors’ browsers load that image from its own website.

Some of these providers are based in or operate from outside the European Union, notably in the United States. Where that is the case, the transfer relies on the safeguards the law provides (such as the EU–US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses).

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep your data until you delete it. Deleting your account removes your wishlists and wishes, your comments, pledges, reservations and invitations on other people's lists, and your account itself.

Two details: a gift you marked as purchased stays marked as purchased (only your identity is removed), so the owner is not told it is still unbought. And a pot you organise passes to its largest remaining pledger, who then sees the pledges; it is deleted only if nobody else pledged.
Backups, if any are made, may keep deleted data until they are discarded.
Abuse counters expire automatically. Invitations you sent are removed with your account.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can see and correct your details on your profile page, download all your data as a file from there, and delete your account at any time. You can also contact us to exercise your rights under the GDPR (access, rectification, erasure, portability, objection), or complain to your data-protection authority (in France, the CNIL). We answer within one month. You can also ask us to limit the processing of your data.

sections.title: Age
paragraphs: Kageo is for people aged 15 and over, or younger with a parent’s agreement.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: If this policy changes in a way that matters to you, we will update the date above and, where it makes sense, tell you in the app.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.draftNotice: These terms are a draft that has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer.

sections.title: About Kageo
paragraphs: Kageo lets you keep wishlists, share them, and coordinate gifts with the people you share them with: reserve a gift, mark it as bought, suggest a wish, pledge to a pot, comment. By creating an account or signing in with Google you accept these terms and the privacy policy.

sections.title: Your account
items: You must be at least 15 years old, or have the agreement of a parent or guardian.
Give accurate details and keep your password to yourself. You are responsible for what happens under your account.
You can delete your account at any time from your profile; see the privacy policy for what is removed.

sections.title: Viewing and acting
paragraphs: Anyone with the link can view a shared wishlist. Reserving a gift, commenting, pledging to a pot or suggesting a wish needs an account, and on a private list an invitation to the email address you sign in with.

sections.title: The surprise
paragraphs: Kageo keeps gifts a surprise: the owner of a wishlist never sees its reservations, pots or the comments guests leave. Please do not try to get around this, and do not share what you see as a guest with the list owner.

sections.title: Pots
paragraphs: A pot only records what people intend to give. Kageo does not collect, hold or transfer money, and a pledge is not a binding commitment. Settling up happens between the people involved, outside Kageo, and Kageo is not a party to it.

sections.title: Your content
paragraphs: You keep ownership of what you write and add (lists, wishes, comments, image links). You allow Kageo to store it and show it to the people you chose so that the service works. You promise that it is yours to share and that it is not unlawful, hateful, harassing, misleading, or an infringement of anyone’s rights. Product details imported from a web link come from that website; check them before you rely on them.

sections.title: Acceptable use
items: No spam, no fake accounts or reservations, no attempt to break, overload or scrape the service, and no use to harass someone.
Invite people you know, and only to lists you want them to see. Each invitation sends them an email in your name.

sections.title: Availability
paragraphs: Kageo is provided as is. We do our best to keep it running and your data safe, but we cannot promise it will always be available or free of errors. Check important dates and gift details yourself.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: To the extent the law allows, Kageo is not liable for indirect damage, for a gift that is bought twice or not at all, or for what users write. Nothing here limits a liability that cannot be limited by law.

sections.title: Suspension
paragraphs: We may remove content or suspend an account that breaks these terms or puts others or the service at risk, and we will say why when we can.

sections.title: Changes to Kageo and to these terms
paragraphs: Kageo will evolve, and paid options may be added later. Lists stay unlimited and guests are never asked to pay. If these terms change in a way that matters, we will update the date above and tell you in the app, and you can delete your account if you do not agree.

sections.title: Law and disputes
paragraphs: These terms are governed by French law. If you have a problem, write to us first so we can fix it. If you are a consumer you may also use a consumer mediator and the courts of your place of residence.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.draftNotice: This policy is a draft that has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer.

sections.title: No banner, on purpose
paragraphs: Kageo only sets cookies and local-storage entries that are strictly necessary to run the service or to remember a choice you made. These do not need your consent, so there is no cookie banner. We use no advertising, no analytics and no tracking, and no third-party cookies of our own.

sections.title: Cookies
items: next-auth.session-token: keeps you signed in. Lasts up to 30 days.
next-auth.csrf-token and next-auth.callback-url: protect the sign-in form and remember the page to return to after signing in. They last for your visit (session cookies).
NEXT_LOCALE: remembers your language. Lasts up to one year.
kageo-theme: remembers light or dark mode, if you choose one. Lasts one year.

sections.title: Local storage
items: kageo-theme: the same theme choice, kept in your browser.
kageo:installPromptDismissedAt: remembers that you closed the “install the app” banner.

sections.title: Google sign-in
paragraphs: If you choose “Continue with Google”, you are sent to Google, which sets its own cookies under its own policy. Kageo only receives your name and email address back.

sections.title: Your choices
paragraphs: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. Kageo will still show public lists, but you will not be able to stay signed in. If we ever add analytics or other optional cookies, we will ask for your consent first and update this page.
